changeSet.author: howners
changeSet.sql: UPDATE payments p SET amount = r.monthly_rent + COALESCE(r.charges, 0), updated_at = NOW() FROM rentals r, users u WHERE r.id = p.rental_id AND u.id = p.payer_id AND u.email LIKE '%@howners.test' AND p.payment_type = 'RENT' AND p.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') AND p.amount <> r.monthly_rent + COALESCE(r.charges, 0);

changeSet.author: howners
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO receipts (id, rental_id, payment_id, receipt_number, period_start, period_end, amount, currency, created_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), p.rental_id, p.id, 'Q-' || to_char(p.due_date, 'YYYY-MM') || '-' || substr(p.id::text, 1, 8), date_trunc('month', p.due_date)::date, (date_trunc('month', p.due_date) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date, p.amount, p.currency, NOW() FROM payments p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.payer_id WHERE u.email LIKE '%@howners.test' AND p.payment_type = 'RENT' AND p.status = 'PAID' AND p.due_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts rc WHERE rc.payment_id = p.id);

changeSet.author: howners
changeSet.sql: -- ::timestamp explicite : le cast implicite date -> timestamptz n'est pas -- IMMUTABLE (dépend du fuseau) et est refusé dans un index d'expression. CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uk_payments_rent_month ON payments (rental_id, (date_trunc('month', due_date::timestamp))) WHERE payment_type = 'RENT' AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED', 'FAILED');
